entries.message: New windows open at the sidebar width you last chose, rather than the default width.
Tapping just below the sidebar’s Show more tabs arrow scrolls the list instead of opening the tab behind it, and VoiceOver names the arrow on iPhone and iPad.
Clear Unpinned Tabs and Shift-Command-K clear the Space’s open tabs, as the sidebar’s Clear does, however recently they were used.
The inline address completion and the search provider chip in the command bar no longer flicker while you type.
On Mac, a notice at the top of the window names each download as it finishes.
On Mac, the address field can show a Copy URL button beside Site Controls. Turn it on in Settings › Appearance › Address field.
On Mac, Crest appears in Finder’s Open With menu for PDFs, without becoming your default PDF app.
Crest stays more responsive with many Spaces and extensions: pages scroll smoothly while extensions such as ad blockers update their badge counts, and loading a page saves the session less often.
Quitting after a session save failed tries that save again, instead of waiting for it to time out.
On iPhone and iPad, dropping a dragged tab on a Space icon in the sidebar moves it to that Space.
On Mac, with Show sidebar on hover in full screen turned on, a full-screen page stays full screen when you swipe to another Space, and takes over the window again when you swipe back.
